Subject: Nimbus intake — initial doc request and PO path

Hi Laura / Nimbus procurement team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood Inference — excited to get you set up. Procurement asked me to collect the following so we can complete our vendor activation and issue a PO: 

- Signed DPA (we can accept a DocuSign envelope or signed PDF). If you prefer, please send a draft we can run by Legal.
- A link to your latest SOC 2 report (read-only link is fine) and any SOC 2 scope notes.
- Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred).
- Billing contact and whether invoices should reference a PO number.
- Any procurement-specific PO terms (e.g., mandatory PO language, required PO number format).

Attachment checklist (if you have ready items): DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor CSV, W-9 or equivalent.

Notes on our side: once DPA and compliance artifacts are received we typically route to Legal for redlines (if any). Our Finance team issues the PO after the contract/DPA is signed and we confirm invoicing details. Typical turnaround is 3–7 business days for internal review.

Can you send the DPA draft and SOC2 link by end of week? If you prefer, we can initiate a DocuSign envelope — happy to accept either flow.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
